metadata.description: VOICE_TEAM output routing config. All agents MUST read this file before writing any output. Never write to repo root or other team folders.

note: All paths are absolute. Agents validate workspace boundary against VOICE_TEAM/ prefix.

usage_guide.deployments: One JSON per deployed firm. Contains agent_id, conversation_flow_id, phone_number, deployed_at, last_modified.
usage_guide.call_logs: Raw call transcripts pulled from Retell API. One JSON per call_id (canonical name: call_<id>.json).
usage_guide.summaries: Post-call analysis output. One JSON per call_id with structured fields (caller name, slot, urgency, etc).
usage_guide.bookings: Booking outcomes from book_pending_consults.py runs. One JSON per booking attempt with success/failure.
usage_guide.emails: Email summary intents. One JSON per call_id. Consumed by Claude Code to dispatch via mcp__google-workspace__send_gmail_message.
usage_guide.dumps: Debug artifacts and one-off snapshots — template flow dumps, plan archives, codex reviews, ad-hoc inspections. Safe to delete; not load-bearing.
usage_guide.firm_configs: Per-firm YAML configs (firm.yml). One per onboarded firm. Source of truth for deployments.
usage_guide.kb_root: Knowledge base docs per firm in <firm_slug>/ subdirectories. Uploaded to Retell KB during deployment.
